name: Texture Maker Enterprise Co., Ltd
summary: Texture Maker Enterprise Co., Ltd. (6963.TWO) specializes in the creation and distribution of a variety of baked goods and milk tea items. The company's offerings fall into three primary segments: Baking products, Milk tea products, and Raw Materials. Their selection of baked goods includes popular items such as rice donuts, muffins, Korean bread, and fruit balls. For milk tea enthusiasts, they provide products like creamers, powdered mixes for frozen beverages, and convenient three-in-one drink powders. Additionally, Texture Maker supplies fundamental raw ingredients, specifically wheat protein and tapioca starch. The company was founded on December 26, 2003, by Jen You Tseng, and maintains its headquarters in New Taipei, Taiwan.
